page.layout: One printed page, two columns of index entries under the running title "INDEX." at the head. Left column, then right column. No margin notes, no footnotes.

main_text.head: INDEX.
H.
main_text.l: Heinricus IV sive Magnus, Rex Gallia & Navarra 49
Heinricus, Dux Andegavensis, Rex Poloniæ creatur 87
Hispania occupatur a West Gothis 37. a Saracenis 38

page.notes: Two-column index on the page; the column divider is a vertical rule. Page numbers stand at the right of each entry, with the second column's numbers following on the same lines. The entries marked with a superscript numeral ("Heinricus Auceps Imperator", "Hispania occupatur ... a Saracenis") have printed superscripts that I could not fully resolve; the bottom entry "Hispa-" is cut off by the page edge. Some printed numerals in the right column are set high and may be misaligned by the scan; readings of "9 6" and "5 8" are the most doubtful. The left-margin/gutter area is shadowed and the top-left is blurred, so spelling of the first entry "Granadense" and the "Gviscardus" line is a best reading.
